_comment: Pinned Wikipedia raw-wikitext snapshots for the WS-A-2026 ingest. Each snapshot is the exact revision fetched (action=query&prop=revisions, main slot content) and is committed so the 2026 ingest is self-contained and byte-deterministic without a live network fetch (mirrors the Fjelstul vendored-source strategy). License: CC-BY-SA 4.0. Re-pin = bump revid + re-run the ingest + commit.
